name: InventionDisclosureReviewBoard
tagline: From invention disclosure to filing decision – scored, minuted and deadline-safe.
description: A complete IP committee app in one PCF control: intake of invention disclosures, a pipeline board, weighted committee scoring with File / Trade secret / Defensive publication recommendations, decision minutes and bar-date protection before public disclosure.
features: Stage rules with required fields per stage
Bulk assign / schedule / triage with undo
Phone layout with bottom view bar
react: 16.14.0 bundled (no platform libraries, no Fluent UI)
controlType: standard (InventionDisclosureReviewBoard data-set control + InventionDisclosureReviewBoardPortal field control)
